column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each power/battery record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking battery data to the equipment using it.
An enum (PowerStatus_enum) showing the device power state (e.g., Sleep, Charging, On, Off).
An enum (PowerSource_enum) describing the primary energy source (e.g., Wind, Solar, Diesel, Hybrid, Battery).
An enum (ChargingStatus_enum) showing the charging state (e.g., Error, Not Charging, Charging, Full).
A NUMERIC(10,4) measuring the power consumption (in watts).
A NUMERIC(6,3) indicating overall power or energy efficiency (e.g., 95.000%).

JSONB column. Combines metrics describing battery performance, health, and charging status.
Fields: {"current_a":"A NUMERIC(7,3) specifying the current (in amperes) used during charging.","cycles":"A SMALLINT counting the number of charge/discharge cycles for the battery.","health_percent":"A NUMERIC(4,1) indicating the battery’s health status in percentage (e.g., 90.0%).","level_percent":"A NUMERIC(5,2) representing the current battery level percentage.","temperature_c":"A DOUBLE PRECISION value measuring the battery’s temperature in Celsius.","voltage_v":"A NUMERIC(5,2) specifying the voltage (in volts) used during charging."}
